name: kimi-statusline
description: High-performance status line for Kimi Code: session token usage, cache hit rate, 5h/7d quota, sub-agents, git + PR, themes (Rust)

interface.shortDescription: Token usage, cache hit rate, 5h/7d quota, git/PR and themes in the TUI footer
interface.longDescription: Replaces the footer's first line with a configurable, themeable status line written in Rust. Shows whole-session input/output tokens and cache hit rate, your 5-hour / 7-day plan quota with reset times, the heaviest sub-agent model, mode/goal/task badges, git diff stats and the open PR. Configure with `kimi-statusline config` in a terminal.

author: Demogorgon314
